notes.title: Opreax Cup 2021
notes.content:
[b]Opreax[/b] is inviting you to it's fifth edition of biggest Turbo annual event: Opreax Cup 2021, where you race on 32 unique maps with many good players. Since Opreax Cup is a rare annual event, most important is not to win, but to participate, drive together and enjoy the game. 

Everyone is welcome and I hope this community will make a great atmosphere like previous years.
For communication with organizer and further info join this discord channel

[url=https://discord.gg/jhzhw4A]https://discord.gg/jhzhw4A[/url]

Championship is scheduled for 20.11.2021 20:00 CET in online room "Opreax".

[b]Rewards:[/b]

1. 100€
2. shirt + winter hat + badge
3. shirt + winter hat + sticker
4. shirt + badge + sticker

[b]Announcement Trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=ahCjqY2rZTE;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ahCjqY2rZTE[/previewyoutube]

To download and train all newly reworked 32 maps use this link:

[url=https://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1429101-Tracks-Opreax]https://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1429101-Tracks-Opreax[/url]

Have Fun!

notes.title: TRACKMANIA AWARDS 2018: VOTE OPEN!
notes.content:
"It's the time of the year again where we want to remember ourselves to the most memorable and influencial moments, and honor the people from the community doing all the work and who we love and follow since years. Let's give them your vote for the Trackmania Awards 2018!

FORMAT
- 1st of December to 31st of December
- 26 awards
- 4 nominees in each award, chosen by our jury
- you are in charge of voting for the winner!

VOTING PROCEDURE
- voting on our special page: [url]http://huntmania.net/awards[/url]
- you need to log in with your Maniaplanet account
- everything should be self-explanatory when you visit the website ;)

SCHEDULE
- each day until 24th new categories (+ video episodes) will be released at 18:00 CET
- you can vote for all categories until 31st of December
- winners will be announced in one big video episode at 8th of January 2019

AWARDS TEAM
- Jury 2018: Scottie, shorty, maeix, Skadi & harni
- HuntMania: NMD & Jonniboy
- Video maker: Lauz

VOTE FOR THE FIRST CATEGORY NOW!
The first one is already out!
Vote on: [url]http://huntmania.net/awards[/url]
Don't know who to vote for? Watch the episode for the first category: [url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CN7q2fvnQNM[/url]

Have fun!"

Article from Huntmania :
[url]https://www.facebook.com/huntmania/photos/a.1689225731329680/2178249602427288/?[/url]
